decision_rule: Retain both complete tested exploratory workflows for diagnostic replication because each produced one finite source pass and one failure, on distinct domains. Neither is a qualified optimizer or recommended promotion. No directly comparable full-quality pair or failure-inclusive resource advantage is established; the observed source-yield differences warrant measuring repeatability, not a confirmatory label. Four assigned pairs each follow the frozen finite allocation, with at least two domains each. No source-specific repair or retuning between repetitions.
assignment_rule: D-P01..04 -> D-S1-v1 unchanged C-S1-v2 science; D-P05..08 -> D-S2-v1 unchanged C-S2-v2 science. Four fresh matched pairs each, multiple domains each; common activation/completion mechanics, Luna Max Standard, exact inputs and unchanged maximum time contracts in both arms.
